```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tseries)
library(urca)
library(forecast)
library(lmtest)
library(FinTS)
library(rugarch)
library(xts)
set.seed(123)

# 1. PERSIAPAN DATA & PLOT
AIMS <- read_excel("D:/STIS/ARW/UAS/DATA UAS_222413767.xlsx", sheet = "no1")
aims = data.frame(Tanggal = as.Date(AIMS$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
                  Harga   = AIMS$Price)
aims <- aims[order(aims$Tanggal), ]

# Menghitung log return (%)
harga = aims$Harga
ret = diff(log(harga)) * 100
tgl = aims$Tanggal[-1]
ret_xts = xts(ret, order.by = tgl)

# VISUAL 1: Harga penutupan, return, ACF dan PACF return
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(aims$Tanggal, harga, type = "l", main = "Harga Penutupan AIMS", xlab = "", ylab = "Rupiah")
plot(tgl, ret, type = "l", main = "Log Return AIMS", xlab = "", ylab = "Return (%)")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
acf(ret,  main = "ACF Return")
pacf(ret, main = "PACF Return")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Statistik deskriptif & normalitas
summary(ret)
jarque.bera.test(ret)

# 2. UJI STASIONERITAS & MODEL ARIMA
adf_ret = ur.df(ret, type = "none", lags = 2)
summary(adf_ret)

best_model = auto.arima(ret, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE, trace = TRUE)
coeftest(best_model)

# Ekstrak orde untuk mean.model GARCH
p_order = arimaorder(best_model)[1]
q_order = arimaorder(best_model)[3]
mean_ada = "intercept" %in% names(coef(best_model))
res_ret = resid(best_model)

# Uji autokorelasi residual model mean
Box.test(res_ret, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = p_order + q_order)
Box.test(res_ret, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = p_order + q_order)

# VISUAL 2: ACF residual dan residual kuadrat
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(res_ret,   main = "ACF Residual ARMA")
acf(res_ret^2, main = "ACF Residual Kuadrat ARMA")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 3. UJI EFEK ARCH
ArchTest(res_ret, lags = 5)
ArchTest(res_ret, lags = 10)

# 4. PEMODELAN ARCH/GARCH (distribusi Student-t karena return tidak normal)
fit_model = function(model, order) {
  spec = ugarchspec(variance.model = list(model = model, garchOrder = order),
                    mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(p_order, q_order), include.mean = mean_ada),
                    distribution.model = "std")
  ugarchfit(spec, data = ret_xts, solver = "hybrid")
}
fit.arch1   = fit_model("sGARCH",   c(1, 0))
fit.garch11 = fit_model("sGARCH",   c(1, 1))
fit.egarch11 = fit_model("eGARCH",  c(1, 1))
fit.tgarch11 = fit_model("gjrGARCH", c(1, 1))

# Perbandingan AIC
cat("ARCH(1)     : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.arch1)[1, 1], "\n")
cat("GARCH(1,1)  : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.garch11)[1, 1], "\n")
cat("EGARCH(1,1) : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.egarch11)[1, 1], "\n")
cat("TGARCH(1,1) : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.tgarch11)[1, 1], "\n")

# 5. MODEL TERBAIK (AIC terkecil): GARCH(1,1)
fit.garch11
cat("Persistence (alpha1 + beta1):", persistence(fit.garch11), "\n")

# Diagnostik residual terstandar
z = as.numeric(residuals(fit.garch11, standardize = TRUE))
Box.test(z,   lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = p_order + q_order)
Box.test(z,   lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = p_order + q_order)
Box.test(z^2, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(z^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
ArchTest(z, lags = 5)
ArchTest(z, lags = 10)

# VISUAL 3: Conditional volatility
plot(tgl, sigma(fit.garch11), type = "l", col = "blue",
     main = "Conditional Volatility GARCH(1,1) Saham AIMS",
     ylab = "Volatilitas (Standar Deviasi)", xlab = "Waktu")

# VISUAL 4: ACF residual terstandar dan kuadratnya
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(z,   main = "ACF Standardized Residual")
acf(z^2, main = "ACF Squared Std. Residual")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 6. PERAMALAN VOLATILITAS 10 HARI KE DEPAN
fcy_garch = ugarchforecast(fit.garch11, n.ahead = 10)
fcy_garch
f_var = sigma(fcy_garch)^2
f_var
plot(fcy_garch, which = 3)
```
